CustomField.description: For Related_Record resolution: the lookup/relationship field on the source target's object that points to this target's record. Example: if source target resolved an Account, and this field is "Primary_Contact__c", the system queries Account.Primary_Contact__c to find this target's Contact ID.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Field on the source target's object that points to this target's record. E.g. "Primary_Contact__c" on Account.
CustomField.label: Related Field Path
